scripts.build: npm run build:worker && npm run build:owner
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w worker-app && npm run typecheck -w owner-app
scripts.deploy:counter: npm run build:worker && npx --yes firebase-tools deploy --only hosting:broiler-pos --config ../firebase.json --project broiler-pos
scripts.deploy:owner: npm run build:owner && npx --yes firebase-tools deploy --only hosting:broiler-pos-admin --config ../firebase.json --project broiler-pos
